exampleSql.obj-01:
SELECT p.code, s.counted_at, s.counted_quantity
FROM stocktakes s
JOIN products p ON p.id = s.product_id
WHERE p.code = 'SX-400'
ORDER BY s.counted_at
exampleSql.obj-02:
SELECT m.*
FROM movements m
JOIN products p ON p.id = m.product_id
WHERE p.code = 'SX-400'
ORDER BY m.occurred_at
exampleSql.obj-03:
WITH ledger AS (
  SELECT product_id, occurred_at,
         SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'in' THEN quantity ELSE -quantity END)
           OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY occurred_at) AS book_qty
  FROM movements
)
SELECT l.occurred_at, p.code, l.book_qty
FROM ledger l
JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id
WHERE l.book_qty < 0
ORDER BY l.occurred_at
exampleSql.obj-04:
SELECT p.code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind = 'disposal' THEN m.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS disposed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind = 'in'       THEN m.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS received
FROM movements m
JOIN products p ON p.id = m.product_id
GROUP BY p.code
ORDER BY 1.0 * disposed / received DESC
LIMIT 1
exampleSql.obj-05:
SELECT m.id, p.code, m.occurred_at, m.created_at
FROM movements m
LEFT JOIN disposal_approvals a ON a.movement_id = m.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = m.product_id
WHERE m.kind = 'disposal' AND a.id IS NULL
ORDER BY m.id
exampleSql.obj-06:
SELECT m.id, m.occurred_at, m.created_at, s.name
FROM movements m
JOIN staff s ON s.id = m.recorded_by
WHERE m.created_at > m.occurred_at
ORDER BY m.id
exampleSql.obj-07:
SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM movements m
LEFT JOIN disposal_approvals a ON a.movement_id = m.id
JOIN staff s ON s.id = m.recorded_by
WHERE m.kind = 'disposal' AND a.id IS NULL
GROUP BY s.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
